class.name: IfcOrganization
class.brief_description: A named and structured grouping with a corporate identity. NOTE: The relationships between IfcOrganizations , like a Department within a Company, can be expressed using IfcOrganizationRelationship . NOTE Corresponds to the following entity in ISO-10303-41: organization. HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 1.5.1. IFC 2x4 change: attribute Id renamed to Identification .

members.member: The word, or group of words, by which the organization is referred to.
Text that relates the nature of the organization.
Postal and telecom addresses of an organization. NOTE: There may be several addresses related to an organization.
